files.description: Hourly weather for the city, September 2025 (720 rows, one per hour in time order, no gaps): observed_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), temp_c (degrees C, one decimal; about 2% empty), rain_mm (one decimal), wind_kmh (whole number), sky (clear, cloudy, fog or rain; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Compute six-hour averages of temp_c and wind_kmh, in blocks starting at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00 and 18:00 each day. `result` should be a table indexed by the start of each block with the columns temp_c and wind_kmh, rounded to 2 decimals.
intended_computation: Read weather_hourly.csv, assign each hour to the 6-hour block starting at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00 or 18:00 of its day, and give per block the mean of the non-empty temp_c and the mean wind_kmh, each rounded to 2 decimals; indexed by the block start.

acceptable_variants.notes: the block start may be a timestamp or text

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
